import re
ttl = open(GRAPH_TTL).read()
# find each entity block that has a label matching Perimeter_top_ZN_3 (no "Room")
# Split by "\n\n"
blocks = re.split(r'\n\n+', ttl)
for b in blocks:
    lab = re.search(r'rdfs:label "([^"]+)"', b)
    ent = re.search(r'^(bldg:[\w.]+)', b, re.M)
    if lab and lab.group(1) in ("Perimeter_top_ZN_3","Perimeter_mid_ZN_3"):
        types = re.findall(r'a (brick:\w+)', b)
        pts = re.findall(r'brick:hasPoint (bldg:[\w.]+)', b)
        exts = re.findall(r'tsref:([\w-]+)', b)
        print("ENTITY:", ent.group(1) if ent else "?", "| label:", lab.group(1))
        print("  types:", types)
        print("  points:", pts)
        print("  exts:", exts)
        print("---")

blocks = re.split(r'\n\n+', ttl)
# find blocks referencing the zone
for b in blocks:
    if 'Zone_F4_Z02' in b or 'Zone_F3_Z02' in b:
        ent = re.search(r'^(bldg:[\w.]+)', b, re.M)
        pts = re.findall(r'brick:hasPoint (bldg:[\w.]+)', b)
        types = re.findall(r'a (brick:\w+)', b)
        ifpt = re.findall(r'brick:isPointOf (bldg:[\w.]+)', b)
        lab = re.search(r'rdfs:label "([^"]+)"', b)
        print("ENTITY:", ent.group(1) if ent else "?", "|", lab.group(1) if lab else "")
        print("  types:", types, "| ifpts:", ifpt)
        print("  points:", pts)
        print("---")
